root_cause_label: IPython Prototyping Spiral Without Writing Required Artifact
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent adopted a research-notebook prototyping strategy that exhausted all 31 steps on planning, environment setup, and IPython-cell experiments without ever writing the required /app/fit_model.py script, ending in repeated execution timeouts and a runtime crash.
t_err_evidence: Step 8 initiates the IPython-cell-based prototyping approach to explore data interactively, committing to a workflow that treats /app/fit_model.py as a final deliverable rather than the first thing to write; the agent's plan (step 1) explicitly defers script creation to step 4 of 5, ensuring the artifact is never created before resources run out.
t_commit_evidence: Step 29 produces the second execution timeout during featurization of even the reduced 10k-sample subset; at this point there are only 2 steps left, no fit_model.py exists, and subsequent step 31 crashes the runtime entirely, making recovery impossible.
t_surface_evidence: Step 25 produces the first execution timeout (120s) when attempting to featurize 5 molecules with np.array(morgan_fp) conversion, the first observable signal that the pipeline approach will not complete within the time budget.
trigger_explanation: The agent committed to a lengthy exploration-first strategy (downloading data, inspecting schema, prototyping featurization in IPython cells) before writing any part of the required /app/fit_model.py. The task explicitly required creating a script with a featurize_smiles function; the agent's plan listed script creation as step 4 of 5 and spent 28 of 31 steps on prerequisite exploration, leaving no budget to write and test the actual artifact.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 5-16 show a cascade of environment errors: pip install awscli fails (exit -1), empty bash command fails (step 6), missing pip module (step 11), missing pyarrow/sklearn/rdkit (steps 10,15,16). These early obstacles consumed significant budget before any productive work, foreshadowing the resource exhaustion that would prevent completion.
